text:
Elaine: Quick async check — mid-quarter ship scrub. Can owners for routing runtime and model catalog call out: what actually shipped last sprint, what slipped, and one clear next step each? :eyes:

Samir: Routing runtime: canary of smart-routing policy rollout shipped to eu-west last Thurs. :ship: Latency tests look stable.

Jordan: Dedicated autoscale for v2 slipped — infra migration + node kernel mismatch caused perf regressions, blocked by storage migration. Estimated slide 2 weeks. :disappointed:

Maya: Catalog work (model metadata & perf profiles) shipped batching API for uploads, but UI filters delayed (needs endpoint changes). Next step: Samir/Jordan to cut stable API contract by Tue.

Samir: Confirming — I merged the canary rollout PR and validated prefix cache warmup. Metrics: p50 from 110ms -> 95ms on canary. PR: #4281.

Kai: For autoscale slip — what deps remain on storage team? Who's owning the migration follow-up? @Jordan?

Jordan: @Kai yep I'm owning the follow-up. Blockers: storage shard rebalance (StorageTeam), and a CVE we had to patch in the node image. Action: I'll schedule a cross-team sync and post plan by EOD Monday.

Elaine: Good. For product-facing comms, please add a one-line note for release notes and an impact sentence for customers (expected window, mitigation). Maya, can you draft?

Maya: Yep — will post a short blurb and a follow-up doc with rollback instructions.

Samir: Small CR ping: reviewers for #4279 (cache eviction fix) and #4283 (kv-cache perf tweak) please. Both touch routing runtime path. TL;DR — fixes reduce cold-start token cost.

Jordan: Reviewing #4279 now. Noted a test gap for extreme sequence length, will add a unit.

Samir: Thx. Quick deploy snippet I used for canary (for context):

```bash
redwood deploy --env=canary --pool=routing-canary --image=runtime:v2.3.1 --annotate "smart-routing-canary"
```

Samir: If anyone runs the deploy, ensure `--pool` matches the canary pool or it'll hit prod.

DeployBot: [deploy-monitor] Canary rollout for routing-runtime started at 2024-07-12T14:22:03Z. 12/30 instances up, 0 errors.

Jordan: Re: model catalog UI filters — Maya and I paired yesterday. Blocking API change is small (add `filter_tags` param). Samir, can runtime team support a minor schema bump?

Samir: Yes, adding `filter_tags` to the metadata schema is fine; will schedule a minor patch and coordinate versioned contract. Expect done by Tue AM.

Kai: Ownership summary for notes:
- Routing runtime: Samir (owner) — shipped canary, next step finish CRs and promote after canary run.
- Dedicated autoscale: Jordan (owner) — slipped, follow-up + cross-team sync Mon.
- Model catalog: Maya (owner) — API contract stable soon, UI filters next sprint.

Elaine: Perfect. One ask: please add a short consequences/rollback line for each item in the doc — helps SRE and support.

Maya: Will add rollback steps + impact. I'll post the release note draft here when ready.

Samir: Quick heads-up: I'll open a small changelog PR for runtime config to document `filter_tags` schema bump.

Jordan: I'll loop in StorageTeam and set the Monday sync.

Elaine: Thanks all — if you have any follow-ups, drop them here. Otherwise we'll fold this into the midq status doc. :white_check_mark:
